description: Schedule a one-shot HTTP POST to a callback URL after a delay, so you can be woken up later without staying alive or polling. Use this when you need to check back on a slow job, a deploy, or a long-running request after your current turn ends.

callback_url.description: Public URL to POST to when the timer fires.

delay_sec.description: Seconds to wait before firing, from 1 to 86400 (24 hours).

payload.description: Arbitrary JSON delivered as the POST body.

name: schedule_agent_wakeup
